title: Kansas Guardsman Receives Car Donation After Tornado
description: Master Sgt. Jeffrey Norling, a Reading tornado survivor and member of the Kansas Air National Guard, received a donated car from Cars4Heroes. Norling’s home was destroyed May 21 by the  tornado that hit Reading. Norling is a member of the 190th Air Refueling Wing at Forbes Field in Topeka and works full-time as a Kansas state trooper. He was returning from a fishing trip with his son when he saw the tornado rip through the town. His wife and youngest daughter survived the tornado by taking refuge in the home’s master bathroom – the only room that remained after the tornado.
keywords: tornado, Kansas National Guard, Kansas, Topeka, tornado11, Jeff Norling, 190th ARW, Cars4heroes, kstornado11, Air National Guard

transcript.text: It's hard because we aren't used to receiving. We're almost always used to giving.
And that sometimes is a difficult thing to do. I've had to remind my wife and remind myself
that this is the time I guess it's being paid back.
I get to meet the donors. They want their car to go to a good place. I get to meet the people we give it to.
And then I get to meet them a few years down the road and see if we really made any kind of a difference.
And it's very rewarding to see when we do.
